**Conference verdict: `CHANGE_REQUIRED_WITH_COMPLETE_SCOPED_PROPOSALS_AND_CONTENT_HOLDS`.**

I reviewed all **10 complete procedures, six shared rules, 20 preserved original scenarios, 27 current main cases and their 37 independent subbranches**, plus the five clarification questions and three Current04 local repairs.

**Seven procedures receive `AGREE_WITH_SCOPED_AUTHORSHIP`; three require explicit current-text completions.** The two positive Command Undeath cases remain whole-case content holds. No spell, candidate, or integration file is adopted by this conference.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Download `DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review.zip`](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review.zip)

**Archive:** 235,978 bytes  
**SHA-256:** `9890d5b6f4c8d3a0699304a175dcb10510f939bf5b85d09cf520c9e7109733d6`

Individual files: :chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[REVIEW.json](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review/REVIEW.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}[VERDICT.md](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review/VERDICT.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}[PROPOSED_CORRECTIONS.json](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review/PROPOSED_CORRECTIONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}[Complete proposed rules](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review/PROPOSED_RULES.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}[Case review and prerequisites](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Companion_Life_10_Current_04_Review/CASE_REVIEW.json)

The archive also contains `CORRECTION_MAP.md`, `SOURCE_VERIFICATION.json`, and `EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json`.

## Five clarification decisions

### Q01 — Soulburn and Grand Reservoir: AGREE_WITH_SCOPED_AUTHORSHIP

I propose **permitting Soulburn’s own intrinsic up-to-3-RP recovery**, but only through the explicit new combination rule **`CL10-SOULBURN-RESERVOIR-04`**.

The frozen Wizard card does not name Soulburn or conclusively distinguish its intrinsic HP-conversion output from “another RP-refund feature.” This is therefore a **new, narrowly scoped interface choice**, not a claim that an existing general exemption already authorizes it.

The proposed rule permits only the selected spell’s own output. Grand Reservoir still prohibits another refund feature, generic Overcast, Arcane Fusion, and Dual Cast. Its actual once-per-long-rest use and base-only waiver remain intact; **20 normal HP, components, surcharges, cadence, and interruption consequences remain real**.

The complete new independent subbranch uses the supplied Wizard20:

| Stage | RP | Normal HP | Reservoir use |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Initial | 0/80 | 31/122 | 1 |
| Commit: waive base7, pay20 HP | 0 | 11 | 0 |
| Successful intrinsic recovery3 | **3** | **11** | **0** |

The original zero-recovery comparator remains preserved. A prevented or countered resolution restores nothing and refunds no committed cost or use.

Ordinary undiscounted Soulburn still loses **4 RP and 20 HP**. Neither the positive limited-waiver branch nor the removal of the old proposed rest cap is a numerical-balance conclusion.

### Q02 — Wraith gripping anatomy: AGREE_WITH_SCOPED_AUTHORSHIP

Select **two usable ordinary gripping extremities** through **`CL10-WRAITH-HANDLING-04`**.

They allow compatible holding, pickup, and release only through actual interaction/Action and companion-command permissions. They grant no additional Action, weapon attack, proficiency, consumable-use privilege, or skilled work.

The chest remains an actual **20 lb / 2 Load** item, below the Wraith’s Burdened threshold of 3 Load. Its entry-floor drop is legal before traversal. **The chest never inherits incorporeal movement.**

### Q03 — Ghast cone: AGREE_WITH_SCOPED_AUTHORSHIP

Select **`CL10-GHAST-CONE-04`**, limited to this Ghast’s native Exhale action—not an imported DI7 or global cone rule.

It uses the actual oral outlet, a declared direction, a 15-foot axial extent, and circular cross-sections whose diameter equals forward distance. A qualifying actual body-interior intersection must also have clear line of effect from that same outlet.

The supplied witnesses remain valid: **5.5 feet forward, 1 foot radial, within the local radius of 2.75 feet**. The existing shared poison pool **7** therefore produces **3** on the successful CON save and **7** on failure.

The replacement corrects the current note suggesting inherited cone geometry. It preserves the missing hand, actual armor, native-action classification, command cost, and damage outcomes.

### Q04 — Wraith physical mass: AGREE_WITH_SCOPED_AUTHORSHIP

Select **0 lb for this one generated manifestation**, explicitly through **`CL10-WRAITH-MASS-04`**.

That is an authored profile value—not an inference from “soul,” “Undead,” or “incorporeal.” It does not reduce the Wraith’s **Medium 5×5 occupied space**, measured height, or its ordinary cargo limits.

Where another source independently permits carrying this distinct creature, the accepted **6 casualty Load for a Medium body** still applies, plus applicable gear Load. Real items retain their pounds. No generic carrying permission, forced-movement immunity, support exception, or physical-law conclusion is created.

### Q05 — Exact-CR2 target: AGREE / CONTENT HOLD

**Keep both positive Command Undeath cases held.** The supplied source-only bestiary does not provide an authoritative operative exact-CR2 Undead target.

The appropriate next step is a **separate complete native NPC profile/source conference**, covering the actual rating, type, body, lifecycle, statistics, defenses, actions, schedule, equipment, agency, and control interactions. No such profile is authored or accepted here.

The known-unrated Ghast rejection is useful negative evidence. It does not prove a positive Command encounter, and none of the four Create Undead profiles receives an invented CR2 rating.

## Three local repairs: AGREE

| Repair | Verified conclusion |
|---|---|
| **Ghast Padded armor** | Actual Padded is **8 lb / 0.8 Load**. With the coat, total gear is **10 lb / 1 Load**. DEX12 gives +1, so worn AC is **11+1 = 12**, replacing base14. Nonproficiency remains real, but the chosen CON-save magical-nonspell Exhale is not a STR/DEX attack or a spell cast that manufactures an RP surcharge. |
| **Gift countering Wizard** | The full Wizard9 has **56 HP, 32 RP, INT18/PB4**, and the actual class Counterspell. **12+4+4 = 20** meets **10+2×rank5 = 20**. It costs **Reaction/3 RP**, leaves29 RP, starts its **2-round recharge**, and retains actual first-distinct-matrix Dissonance handling. |
| **Paid command before suppression** | The owner’s actual **BA at6.05** precedes readied release **6.1**, owner turn-end **6.25**, and attached opportunity **6.5**. The command was genuinely legal and paid before suppression; it is then lost at the suppressed/ended opportunity, without a replacement command or phase. |

## One remaining timing-field correction

In `CL10-SUPPRESSION-BRANCHES`, the preparation event still labels **t5** as successful spell establishment:

**Pointer:** `/currentCases/23/events/1/durationStart`

The numeric release and expiry elsewhere are already correct. The complete proposed case replacement harmonizes this field and its preparation-check wording:

**t5:** Ready cast/payment/cadence and held concentration.  
**t6.1:** select and recheck the area point; establish the field.  
**t66.1:** nominal one-minute field deadline.  
**t13:** this fixture’s actual voluntary ending.

No RP, command, suppression geometry, or later clock changes are proposed.

## Retained procedure and lifecycle conclusions

The seven procedures requiring no additional operating-text change are **Summon Corpse Golem, Summon Death Knight, Grave Gift, Negative Energy Flood, Danse Macabre, Command Undeath, and Create Homunculus**, within their stated proposed scopes and case limitations.

In particular, the different suppression outcomes remain distinct: the Golem/Wraith/Homunculus end; the Knight uses its source-specific absent-body pause; Flood/Danse retain inert physical bodies; Create Undead retains permanent flesh while its authority or magical expression is suppressed.

Null does not replace those independent endings or grant generic living-ally healing. Wraith funding also remains exact: **Burden Shared’s `14→4+5+5` funds only4, healing2; Life Linked’s `14−2→6+6` funds only the original6, healing3**. The transferred shares are excluded by their actual sources before applying the Wraith’s donor filter.

## Verification and preservation

The exact submitted archive and **1,640,673-byte Current04 candidate** match their supplied hashes. All **63 manifest-listed raw source/evidence files** and **46 retained plus10 added nested bindings** verify.

The prior **11 additions replay and reverse exactly**. Current04’s three local before/after objects also match. The new report supplies **nine complete reversible proposed operations**: full procedure completions, full changed cases with their old Current04 versions, and a clearly proposed conference layer. All **27 main case IDs/order**, **20 historical scenario texts**, ten source/access records, four undead alternatives, and earlier procedure fields remain intact.

The source report explicitly records one unavailable **historical-only backward link** inside the preserved pending Dominate Monster comparison. Its complete comparison object is present; that backlink is not treated as current authority or hidden behind a claim that every historical pointer resolves.

**No input, source, catalog, or index was changed.** Counts remain **505 reviewed / 343 pending / 229 standalone according to your reported live state**; Persistent20 application is not inferred. Exact rebound files will still require their later dedicated review.

Accepted AC6 and DE4 stay closed. Video-game-only development and all **75 domain gates** remain separate. This conference approves neither runtime implementation or execution, human gameplay, numerical balance, cosmology/canon, soul/native-origin/deity or era settlement, whole-game completion, publication, release, nor any other queued cohort.
